    • varIntegerType

      @NotNull @CheckReturnValue @NotNull NetSerializerBuilder.NumberFinal<Integer> varIntegerType()
      Based on the VarInt that Minecraft uses. This has the ability to provide a Integer over the network but using between 1-5 bytes instead of the standard 4 bytes that the regular integerType() uses
